facts.fact: Egypt began fully enforcing its 2020 data protection law in early November 2026, per Enterprise.
The executive regulations of the 2020 data protection law came out in 2025 with a one-year compliance grace period, per Enterprise.
facts.system: Executive regulations of the data protection law

facts.fact: The Personal Data Protection Center oversees personal data and launched its online portal in October 2026, per Enterprise.
The data protection regulator launched an online sign-up portal in October 2026, which Enterprise says was barely working the week before 12 November.
